title: uninstaller refuses -PurgeBackup unless the same run also carries -Apply
why: The retention rule is 'did not back it up in this run => must not delete it'. -PurgeBackup without -Apply would delete a backup directory that this run never created, so it must be refused (exit 2) before anything is touched. The refusal must name the rule (purge_without_apply) so the operator can act on it.
inject: an empty fixture plus -PurgeBackup -AsJson and no -Apply, with an explicit -StateDir under the case temp dir
expectSummary: exit 2, refusals[0].reasonKey=purge_without_apply (and journal_required second), temp dir untouched
